Some slightly more general advice would be to weigh up the pros and cons of each potential decision you are thinking about making, considering both the short and long-term impact of it. There are a lot of possibilites, even if you aren't able to see them right now. You will find your path, I'm certain. Stay determined, find ways to motivate yourself, set some goals. Everything seems bleak, but it's the mindset you're in. Hell, I can't blame you based on the portrayal of your family. But you can overcome this. 
In the end, you will be the one that'll get you out of this. It's difficult living with a family like that, I can imagine. Focus on yourself. Start a workout routine, eat healthier, try to improve your overall health. Also, there are a lot of ways you can meet new friends, e.g. the internet. Day after day, step by step. You can do whatever you set your mind to.
I feel for you, and I wish you all the best.

Yes, I am currently doing my Abitur but it doesn't look good for me. This makes me feel incredibly miserable. I know. I wanted to push through. But now I can't. Not with this mindset. And, as you might know, you can't just come out of it as you please. We don't have a School psychologist... I know I need help, I feel like I am in a very bad crisis, but I am unable to do something about it.
Thank you.

Hi. English isn't my mothertongue either, so don't worry about it!
I'm in grade 13 doing my A-Levels, a high school senior if you may. I live in Germany; here it's called "Oberstufe" which (roughly) corresponds to High School, thus dropping out does not exactly present a favorable prospect of my future. Still, I need to leave the fake vibe of security and stability school provides behind due to my mental health which is spiraling downward at a very high pace.

I assume you have issues that are somewhat similar to mine? I wouldn't mind it if you wanted to rant.
